scope: 48 symbolic angle fixtures with nine finite non-rational residuals, four trig families and serialized/public controls. Includes sqrt(2), ln(2), exp(1), atan(1/2), sqrt(2)-1, signed/scaled sqrt(2), and exp(100); lattice/non-lattice periodic coefficients, nearby poles, factored/distributed arithmetic, cancelled extreme offsets and 64 offset wrappers. Four-query cold/warm schedule. Directed 1024-bit MPFR pi and residual enclosures feed exact derivative-one sin/cos intervals and exact quotient bounds. Each process is capped at 192 MiB, CPU 2/3 seconds and wall 4 seconds. Scoped evidence, not an exhaustive proof or matched benchmark.
